query: For Arid Heights Research Annex Global Horizontal Irradiance, hourly history through 2022-02-08 23:00 and forecast window 2022-02-09 00:00–23:00, search separately for: dated GHI sensor, calibration, logging, definition, firmware, or software changes; temporary disruptions with explicit endpoints before the forecast window; persistent atmospheric or instrumentation regimes; scheduled events overlapping 2022-02-09; phase-aligned observations and cycle amplitudes testing robust_phase_template; rolling holdout rankings and disruption representativeness testing holdout_adaptive_cycle_ensemble; cycle-shape correlations and decaying level/amplitude changes testing regime_damped_harmonics; and same-phase versus one-step historical errors testing validated_seasonal_median.

evidence.claim: The site suspended standard maintenance and operated autonomously on February 8 because of a local holiday.
evidence.exact_quote: Please be advised that February 8 is a designated local holiday within the Federative Republic of Althea. On this date, standard maintenance cycles are suspended. The site operates in autonomous mode, and physical access is restricted to emergency protocols only.

impacts.rationale: The documented operational change is confined to February 8 and supplies no quoted evidence that GHI measurement or the latent irradiance process changed. It therefore cannot justify a February 9 adjustment or distinguish the phase-template, holdout-ensemble, damped-harmonic, and seasonal-median candidates.

missing_information: Identification of the sensor that produced the target GHI series and whether it was affected by the February 5 sensitivity loss or February 7 maintenance.
A pre-cutoff statement confirming whether optical sensitivity and calibration were restored before 2022-02-09.
Actual hourly GHI observations available before the cutoff that establish phase stability, peak timing, cycle ranges, and same-phase versus one-step errors.

Earlier legitimate rolling holdout results needed to test whether the holdout_adaptive_cycle_ensemble runner-up has stable model rankings and whether its latest holdout represents a temporary disruption.
Pre-cutoff cycle-shape correlations and level/amplitude changes needed to evaluate regime_damped_harmonics against an unchanged seasonal profile.

A dated pre-cutoff atmospheric report explicitly applicable to Arid Heights and overlapping 2022-02-09; undated references to the current, next, or final cycle cannot be aligned safely to the forecast window.
A scheduled GHI-relevant event with an explicit February 9 time window, applicable target, and documented directional or quantitative effect.
